Name: Calendar Sync Lite
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: Next Meeting
Actions.Tooltip: Your next meeting and a live countdown, right on the key. The key turns amber as it gets close and red when it is about to start. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Agenda
Actions.Tooltip: Everything left on your day, one key at a time. Press to step to the next one.

Description: Never miss the start of a meeting again. Your next event sits on a key with a live countdown, and the key shifts colour as the time closes in, so you catch it from across the room without alt-tabbing. Works with any calendar that gives you a private iCal link, including Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar and Fastmail.
